title: Registry Workflow Record
description: Canonical record for a workflow/routing rule owned by om-router. Lives in the KV_WORKFLOW_REGISTRY bucket and is emitted on the registry.workflow.{id} subject. A workflow defines how events/telemetry/state are matched and what actions (commands, tasks, missions, alerts, Legacy prompts) are produced. See docs/WORKFLOW-ROUTING.md.

enabled.description: Whether this workflow is currently active.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this workflow does.

when.description: Trigger condition — which events match this workflow.

where.description: Optional predicate expression evaluated against the event data (e.g. "data.affiliation == 'hostile' && data.priority == 'critical'").

then.description: Ordered list of actions to execute when the condition matches.

items.description: A single action. Exactly one action type per item.

publish.description: Publish a command or event subject (e.g. 'cmd.mission.create', 'ui.alerts.active').

task.description: Create a task in the Task Engine.

assignee.description: Actor ID to assign the task to.

approval.description: Approval policy for this workflow's commands. 'none' = auto-execute, 'operator_required' = hold for human approval, or a named policy reference.

dry_run.description: When true, the workflow logs matches and would-be actions without executing them. Used for testing.

last_triggered.description: RFC3339 timestamp of the last time this workflow fired.

metadata.description: Workflow-specific metadata (run count, last match details, etc.).
